name: Chão de neve do bioma
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeatable top-down battlemap terrain painting texture. ONE square 1024 x 1024 edge-to-edge texture of natural fine granular powder snow, subtle wind ripples, a few tiny translucent ice granules and restrained cool gray-blue crevices. True orthographic overhead, realistic hand-painted material at a consistent physical scale: the tile represents 3 m by 3 m of ground. Absolutely seamless tile: all four opposite edges must match in tone, material, lighting and detail; no directional shadow, no vignetting, no border, no horizon, no large objects, no figures, no text, no grid, no focal subject, no transparent pixels. Subtle low-frequency variation, rich small material detail. Suitable for repeated large brush strokes without a visible patchwork pattern.
